title: Phyto-fabricated iron oxide nanoparticles from Phyllanthus acidus: a magnetically recoverable nanoadsorbent for rapid Congo red detoxification
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20809-20821
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02105K, Paper
Open Access

Md. Ahad Mahmud Nahim, Asifur Rahman, Jamil Ahmed, Jannatul Naime, Md. Abu Rayhan Khan, Shofiur Rahman, Mahmoud A-Gawati, Habib Md. Ahsan
This study reports the sustainable synthesis of phyto-fabricated magnetite iron oxide nanoparticles (IONPs) using Phyllanthus acidus leaf extract as a natural reducing and capping agent via a green co-precipitation route.
